name: Feishu
description: Use the official Lark CLI and its built-in skills from Vetta conversations.
setup.title: Feishu setup
setup.subtitle: Prepare the official CLI, then connect a Feishu app. Once complete, the agent can use Feishu skills in conversations.
setup.stepCliDescription: Vetta installs the official npm package only when the CLI is missing. It does not add another Vetta tool.
setup.stepAppDescription: Scan to create or connect an app. The App ID identifies it; the App Secret is saved by the official CLI.
setup.authOptional: Personal authorization is optional; the agent can also work with the app identity.
setup.checking: Checking the official CLI and local app configuration…
setup.readyDescription: Vetta can now let the agent use lark-cli directly from its shell.
setup.configure: Create or connect a Feishu app
setup.identityCheckFailed: The current identity could not be verified. You can authorize again or view diagnostics.
setup.authVerifyFailed: The authorization flow ended, but lark-cli could not verify the new user identity.
setup.qrTitleApp: Scan to create or connect a Feishu app
setup.qrTitleAuth: Scan to authorize your Feishu identity
setup.qrWaitingApp: Waiting for lark-cli to prepare the official app setup link…
setup.qrWaitingAuth: Waiting for lark-cli to prepare the official authorization link…
setup.qrInstruction: Scan this QR code with Feishu. Keep this window open until the CLI confirms completion.
setup.qrNoteApp: After scanning, follow the Feishu page to create or connect the app. Vetta never displays the App Secret.
setup.qrNoteAuth: After scanning, follow the Feishu page to finish authorization. You can close this window and continue later.
setup.flowFailed: The CLI setup command ended before configuration completed.
